EmailTemplate.description: Send Production Win Notification to Opportunity Owner and copy the Opportunity Owner's Manager when it is 7 days after the First Customer Ship Date on opportunities that meet the criteria - Stage = Design Win, Opportunity Type contains "Design", Product Segment = "Embedded", "Connected Home" or "Wireless & Connectivity"
EmailTemplate.name: Opportunity Production Win Overdue Notification
EmailTemplate.subject: ALERT: Your Opportunity is Past the Production Start
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Opportunity Owner,
Your opportunity is past the Production Start.
Account Name: {!Opportunity.Account}
Opportunity Name: {!Opportunity.Name}
First Customer Ship Date: {!Opportunity.Core_First_Customer_Ship_Date__c}
Click Here to update the Stage to Production Win if production has begun. If the production start has been postponed, please update the First Customer Ship Date to the current status.
Please make sure the Fulfillment Partner and Manufacturing Region are entered.
If the opportunity will not go into the production, please change the Stage to Production Loss or Production Cancelled accordingly and specify the reason for loss or cancellation. There is no impact in the system on the prior achieved Design Win stage.
